bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot" || exit 31
test "$(pwd -P)" = "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 32
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 33
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 34
root="$(pwd -P)"
if test ! -d .worktrees;then mkdir .worktrees || exit 35;fi
test "$(realpath .worktrees)" = "$root/.worktrees" || exit 36
git fetch --no-tags origin 4d64a4de50a87daa892c47d5760573c7fb8e1ec6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 37
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 4d64a4de50a87daa892c47d5760573c7fb8e1ec6 || exit 38
wt="$root/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127"
if test ! -d "$wt";then git worktree add --detach "$wt" 4d64a4de50a87daa892c47d5760573c7fb8e1ec6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 39
else
 test -z "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain)" || exit 40
 git -C "$wt" checkout --detach 4d64a4de50a87daa892c47d5760573c7fb8e1ec6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 41
fi
test "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4d64a4de50a87daa892c47d5760573c7fb8e1ec6 || exit 42

test "$(realpath "$wt")" = "$root/.worktrees/notice-live-20261127" || exit 44
echo NOTICE_LATEST_SOURCE_IN_CANONICAL_PARENT=PASS
